tasks.short: Clean equipment and make minor repairs.

steps.what: Show the cleaning list for this audio and video equipment.
Perform minor repairs and routine cleaning of audio and video equipment.
Set aside a unit that still fails after the routine cleaning.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the cleaning list already written for that type of audio and video equipment. The technician performs the routine cleaning and the minor repair by hand. A unit that still fails is set aside. The list does not clean anything. A type with no list leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cleaning steps were a laminated card, and a unit that still failed went back on the shelf.
tasks.enabler_now: The card can be shown on screen. The cleaning and the repair stay in the hands.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing dust in a connector, or a switch that still scrapes, takes the technician at the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The technician cleans, repairs, and decides that a unit has not recovered.
tasks.altitude: Cleaning and minor repair stay at the bench. The list is only a reminder of steps already written for that equipment type.

reach.task: Clean and reset a display by hand.
reach.learn: A checklist does not do the cleaning.

evidence.claim: A cleaning list for an equipment type is a reminder of steps already written. It does not perform the cleaning or the repair.
Setting a failed unit aside is the technician's judgement after the work. The list cannot see the failure.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The equipment type and the cleaning list if one is already written. The list is not generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Show the list from the operations notes already kept for that type before writing a new manual.
unknowns: Which repairs this company still calls minor, as against a call to the vendor.
research_questions: Who may condemn a unit after cleaning fails?

already_counted.description: Cleaning, minor repair, and setting a failed unit aside stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Retire a cleaning list when that equipment type leaves the building.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still cleans the equipment and still does the minor repair. Only showing a cleaning list already written for that type is removed. A type with no list saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design the equipment layout and upgrades.

steps.what: Show the stored room measurements and the current equipment.
Design layouts of audio and video equipment and the upgrades.
Mark the maintenance the designed layout still needs.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows room measurements and the current equipment list if both are already stored. The audio technician designs the audio and video layout and the upgrade from the room itself. The technician marks the maintenance the design still needs. The measurements do not draw the layout. A room with no measurements leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements were on a sketch, and the upgrade was chosen without the current equipment list beside it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored measurements can be shown. Designing the layout still happens in the room.
tasks.still_hard: A measurement does not show a pillar, a window, or a cable run that blocks the upgrade.
tasks.human_edge: The technician designs the layout and the upgrade. The stored numbers are only a starting measure.
tasks.altitude: Layout and upgrade decisions stay with the technician in the room. Stored measurements are shown and are not treated as the design.

reach.task: Design a room from a site visit, not from the survey numbers alone.
reach.learn: A stored measurement is not the layout.

evidence.claim: Stored room measurements and an equipment list are records. They do not design a layout or choose an upgrade.
Maintenance marked on a design is the technician's note after seeing the room. The measurement does not write it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The room id, and the measurements and equipment list only if both are already stored. Neither is invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the measurements from the operations record already kept for the room before surveying again.
unknowns: Whether a facilities team, rather than the technician, owns the room measurements.
research_questions: Who approves an upgrade that changes the building, as against the equipment?

already_counted.description: Designing the layout and marking the remaining maintenance stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Update the stored measurements when the room itself is rebuilt.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still designs the layout and the upgrade in the room. Only showing measurements and an equipment list that are already stored is removed. A room with no measurements saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train people on the presentation equipment.

steps.what: List the selected audio-visual materials and the design examples.
Conduct training sessions on use and operation of presentation equipment.
Note which equipment operation was shown in the session.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store lists the audio-visual materials and design examples already selected for the session. The audio technician conducts the training on selection, use, and operation of the presentation equipment. The technician notes which operation was shown. The list does not teach. The note is not a score of the people in the room. A session with no selected materials leaves the list blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The materials were a pile of cables, and what was shown was not written down.
tasks.enabler_now: The selected materials can be listed. The training session still happens in the room.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether a person can operate the equipment after the demonstration stays with the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician conducts the session. The list only names materials already selected.
tasks.altitude: Training stays in the room with the technician. The note lists operations that were shown and does not score the people who attended.

reach.task: Run a session in the room rather than from a list of drills.
reach.learn: A material list is not the training.

evidence.claim: Listing materials already selected for a session is a lookup. It does not conduct the training.
The note lists which operation was shown. It is not a judgement of the people in the room, and it is not used to rank them.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The session id and the materials already selected. The selection is not made by this step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the material list from the document store before building a separate training record.
The note names operations shown. It does not score attendance or skill.
unknowns: Whether attendees are staff, which would make the note an employee record.
research_questions: Who selects the materials before the technician arrives?

already_counted.description: Conducting the session and noting what was shown stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Remove material lists for sessions that have been cancelled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still conducts the training in the room. Only listing materials already selected is removed. The note of what was shown is still written by the technician and is not a score.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor pictures and sound, and notify.

steps.what: Show the names of the incoming and outgoing feeds.
Monitor incoming and outgoing pictures and sound to ensure quality.
Notify directors of possible problems in the picture or the sound.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the names of the incoming and outgoing feeds. The audio technician monitors the pictures and the sound to ensure quality. The technician notifies the director of a possible problem. The feed name does not judge the picture. A meter that already alarms is existing equipment and is not counted as the technician's time. A studio with no feed list leaves the names blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feed names were on gaffer tape, and the director heard about a problem only if the technician could reach the talkback.
tasks.enabler_now: Feed names can be shown. Watching the quality, and telling the director, stay with the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A level can be inside a meter limit and still look or sound wrong to the director.
tasks.human_edge: The technician watches the picture and the sound and decides what the director must hear about.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring stays at the screens. The technician still notifies the director, and an existing meter alarm is not treated as saved labour.

reach.task: Judge whether a picture on a screen is the one they intended.
reach.learn: A feed name is not a quality judgement.

evidence.claim: Showing feed names already assigned is a label. It does not monitor picture or sound quality.
An alarm a meter already raises is the equipment's own runtime. It is not the technician's watching, and it is not counted as saved.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The studio id and the feed names if they are already assigned. The names are not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the feed names from the switcher already in the room. Do not add a second tally.
Existing meter alarms are outside these shares.
unknowns: Whether directors want every glitch or only problems that reach the audience.
research_questions: Which quality problems must stop the show, and which are told afterwards?

already_counted.description: Watching the feeds and notifying the director stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Rename a feed when a source is repatched.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still monitors picture and sound and still notifies the director. Only showing feed names already assigned is removed. A meter that already alarms is not counted, because that time was never the technician's.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technician still cleans and repairs the gear, still designs the layout, still trains people on the equipment, and still watches the picture and the sound. A checklist does not do that work.
reach: Interior designers propose a room layout, and this job learns a stored measurement is not the layout decision.
Coaches and scouts run a session in person, and this job learns equipment training stays in the room.
skills_to_grow: Clean and repair the equipment by hand.
Design a layout from the room, not from the stored measurements alone.
Watch the picture and the sound, and tell the director when either fails.
role.ambitious_version: Hands-on repair, layout, training, and live monitoring stay with the technician. Stored lists only open what is already known.
